entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: The primary substate chosen by the UE when entering the EMM-REGISTERED state. This substate represents normal service operation.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: The main EMM state indicating the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: UE enters EMM-REGISTERED state
entities.description: Condition triggered when the UE transitions into the EMM-REGISTERED state.

relations.description: When the UE enters the EMM-REGISTERED state, it establishes the EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE substate as the primary substate.
EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE is a substate defined within the EMM-REGISTERED state.
